title: Job Portal for Employers & Job Seekers
summary: A full-featured two-sided job portal connecting employers with job seekers through listings, company profiles, applications and role-specific dashboards.
result: Fully operational employer and job-seeker marketplace
challenge: The platform needed separate employer and job-seeker workflows while keeping job discovery, applications and management simple and responsive.
solution: Built employer workflows for company profiles, job posting and application management.
Built job-seeker workflows for browsing listings, viewing job details and applying.
Used Vue.js and Vuetify for a responsive modern frontend.
Used Inertia.js with Laravel for a smooth SPA-style experience.
Focused on clean architecture and scalable design.
outcomes: Delivered complete employer and job-seeker workflows.
Created a responsive, user-friendly SPA experience.
Provided scalable foundations for listings, applications and dashboards.
